text: bh files <path> [--all] --json (node <app home>/mods/bot-herdr/engine/bh.mjs; the mod calls it as bh('files', path, '--json')). Success: exit 0, stdout {path:<absolute normalised>,parent:<absolute|null at a root>,entries:[{name,path:<absolute>,dir:false,size:123,mtime:<epoch ms>}],truncated:false}. Folders first then files, each sorted by name, localeCompare sensitivity base; names starting with a dot hidden unless --all; at most 2000 entries then truncated:true; '~' and relative paths resolve against home/cwd; on Windows path '' or '/' lists the drive roots (each a dir entry, parent null, path is the current drive root); an entry whose stat fails is skipped, never fatal. Failure (missing path, a file, unreadable): exit 1, stdout {error:'<one plain sentence>'}. Logic: engine/lib/files.mjs listFolder(path,{all=false,limit=2000}). Test: test/files.list.test.mjs.

look.js palette is now contrast-repaired: readable(color, bg, target=4.5, ink) binary-searches the smallest mix toward ink then white/black; palette() derives fill from background when a theme has no surface tokens, takes accent from solid or ansi4, and repairs muted/faint/accent/danger/stop/info/success/warning against both fill and ground. accentInk is chosen by polarity (DARK uses #141413). bh models <harness> [--command <exe>] [--refresh] --json (node <app home>/mods/bot-herdr/engine/bh.mjs). <harness> is the Settings key: claude, codex, pi, omp, opencode, gemini, qwen, antigravity; --command overrides the executable (defaults claude, codex, pi, omp, opencode, gemini, qwen, agy). stdout, exit 0: {harness, source: 'harness'|'builtin', method: 'cli'|'acp'|'app-server'|'none', models: [{id, name, efforts?: [..]}], at: <epoch ms>, cached: true|false}. efforts only when the harness reports them. Cannot be asked (not installed, auth, timeout, bad output): exit 0, source 'builtin', the models.js list for that harness or [], plus error: '<one plain sentence>'. Claude: always source 'builtin', method 'none', no error. Exit 1 only for a bad argument (unknown harness; message on stderr). Cache: <app home>/data/bot-herdr/models/<harness>-<command>.json, reused 24 h, --refresh bypasses and rewrites; a failure is never cached. Logic: engine/lib/models.mjs modelsFor(); parsers parseOmp/parsePi/parseOpencode/parseAgy/parseAcpSession/parseCodexModelList. Test: test/models.test.mjs.

palette() now composites every 8-digit theme token onto the surface it sits on (opaque(color, under)): ground over background, fill/border/hover/kbd over ground/fill, bubble=t.selected over ground, text over fill, *__foreground over accent. Every token palette() returns is an opaque #rrggbb; ratios in contrast.test are the drawn ratios. Opaque inputs and derived fallbacks are unchanged.
